pattern: fuzzy string join with best-match dedup, group count compared against a stated column, threshold filter
question: which schools got less than half the applications we expected from them, matching names loosely (each application should count towards only its single best matching school)
gold_sql: WITH best AS (SELECT a."Applicant" AS applicant, o."School Name" AS matched_school, jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(a."School")), lower(trim(o."School Name"))) AS sim FROM lpf_applications AS a JOIN lpf_outreach AS o ON jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(a."School")), lower(trim(o."School Name"))) >= 0.9 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a."Applicant" ORDER BY sim DESC, o."School Name") = 1) SELECT o."School Name", COUNT(b.applicant) AS applications_received, o."Applications Expected" FROM lpf_outreach AS o LEFT JOIN best AS b ON b.matched_school = o."School Name" GROUP BY o."School Name", o."Applications Expected" HAVING COUNT(b.applicant) < o."Applications Expected" / 2.0 ORDER BY o."School Name"

Quote column names with double quotes when they contain spaces or odd characters. When two tables describe the same thing with different column names, UNION ALL them with aligned aliases.

which schools got less than half the applications we expected from them, matching names loosely (each application should count towards only its single best matching school)

WITH matched_schools AS (
    SELECT 
        a."Applicant",
        a."School" AS app_school,
        o."School Name" AS outreach_school,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a."Applicant" ORDER BY jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(a."School")), lower(trim(o."School Name"))) DESC) AS rn
    FROM "lpf_applications" a
    LEFT JOIN "lpf_outreach" o ON 1=1
    WHERE jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(a."School")), lower(trim(o."School Name"))) >= 0.9
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a."Applicant" ORDER BY jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(a."School")), lower(trim(o."School Name"))) DESC) = 1
),
school_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(ms.outreach_school, ms.app_school) AS school_name,
        COUNT(ms."Applicant") AS applications_received
    FROM matched_schools ms
    GROUP BY COALESCE(ms.outreach_school, ms.app_school)
),
expected_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        "School Name",
        SUM("Applications Expected") AS expected_applications
    FROM "lpf_outreach"
    GROUP BY "School Name"
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(sc.school_name, ec."School Name") AS school_name,
    sc.applications_received,
    ec.expected_applications
FROM school_counts sc
FULL OUTER JOIN expected_counts ec ON sc.school_name = ec."School Name"
WHERE sc.applications_received < ec.expected_applications / 2.0
   OR (sc.applications_received IS NULL AND ec.expected_applications > 0)
   OR (sc.applications_received IS NOT NULL AND ec.expected_applications IS NULL) -- Should not happen based on logic but safe guard
   OR (sc.applications_received IS NULL AND ec.expected_applications IS NULL);
